learning_outcomes.text: Configure and troubleshoot EIGRP, OSPF and BGP in enterprise networks
Configure and troubleshoot VPN technologies including DMVPN, MPLS L3VPN and site-to-site VPNs
Implement infrastructure security with ACLs, control-plane policing and device access controls
Configure and troubleshoot infrastructure services including SNMP, syslog, DHCP, IP SLA and NetFlow

integrative_case: A regional enterprise merges two networks after an acquisition: resolve overlapping OSPF/EIGRP domains, interconnect sites with DMVPN and MPLS L3VPN, harden device access, and instrument the edge with IP SLA failover; defend each design choice.
